settings.heading: Commerce. With a point of view.
settings.body: Quadratum is a multipurpose Shopify theme and a growing commerce ecosystem. Its role is to give distinctive brands a considered foundation.

settings.heading: The brand is yours.
settings.body: A reading room should not feel like a performance garage. A wellness store should not speak like a fashion label. Our ten demo worlds explore how one theme can support different identities.
settings.label: Discover the ten worlds

settings.heading: For the people who build.
settings.body:
Agencies, developers, store owners and first-time founders bring different experience to the same task: making a store their customers can understand and use.

Quadratum brings design options and commerce presentation into a shared system that you can learn, adapt and make your own.
